summary.name: Julius
summary.one_liner: Julius is an AI data analysis tool where you upload files, ask questions about your data in plain language, and get visualizations and exportable results.
use_cases: export analysis results to csv or excel
explore uploaded csv, excel, or json files
summary.what_it_does: The page is a getting-started guide for Julius. Users upload files such as CSVs, Excel, JSON, PDFs, and images by clicking the + icon or dragging them into the chat. They then ask questions about the data in plain language, such as averages by category or sorting by a column. Julius can create bar, line, scatter, histogram, and pie charts from a request, and users can right-click a chart to copy or save it. Results can be exported as CSV or Excel, with a download link appearing in the chat.
notable: Plain-language questions over uploaded files, no code required
Generates bar, line, scatter, histogram, and pie charts from text requests
Exports results as CSV or Excel via chat download link
caveats: Pricing and plan limits are not stated on this page
Full list of supported file types is on a separate Files page, not included here
